scope: Independent finite static design checks only; no physical execution, feasibility, safety qualification, source-result replication, solver or runtime-loader validation.

checks.check: Every operation resolves a station
Every operation resolves source references
Every operation resolves input gates
Every branch resolves operations controls sources and gates
Branch gates include all selected operation gates
Each branch has exactly one matching route
All one-pass route graphs are acyclic with local references
Finite loop references are local operations
Operations expose actor manipulation state custody and evidence
Robot translations and device actions are distinguished
Part manufacture contains actual load recover finish inspect actions
Packing proceeds from qualified shape and fabricated inspected parts
Stick insertion precedes thermal actuation
Thermal qualification precedes mechanical acquisition
Mechanical cycle recovers cools then reinserts before next pass
XCT does not silently inherit unconditional mechanical reinsertion control
XCT raw acquisition precedes geometry derivation
XCT scan versus pull sequence ambiguity remains explicit
Hold preparation observation and contained release remain ordered
Continuous extended hold is distinct from repeated pull cycles
DSC and friction preparation precede actual acquisition
Single-rod load and unload history precedes thermal recovery
Aspect ratio and baseline fixture dimensions are distinct
All reported container sizes retained including unresolved largest
Outside versus inside conflict remains explicit and gated
XCT designation is not emitted as a qualified scan recipe
Unspecified rod reference programming remains an input gate
DEM packing count is not an experimental replicate claim
Temperature tolerance is strict and acquisition-linked
Distinct fixed-rod and fixed-total composition comparisons preserved
Lineage distinguishes repacking and protects source-independent raw data
Actor excludes source outcomes and hidden reference route
Source access incompleteness remains visible
Design review does not certify physical device or CAD execution
